name: Barbell Decline Lying Triceps Extension
steps: Set an adjustable bench to a decline, hook your feet, lie back, and hold a barbell over your shoulders close-grip.
Angle your upper arms slightly back behind vertical to keep steady tension on your triceps.
Bend your elbows smoothly to lower the bar just past your forehead while keeping your upper arms still.
Extend your elbows forcefully to press the bar back up to the starting position.
tips: Use a full thumb-around grip and keep your wrists aligned straight with your forearms.
Keep your elbows pointed upward rather than letting them flare far out to the sides.
